Body.Content:
An update to the public preview of the Microsoft Azure Automation Graphical Authoring SDK has been released. The update includes support for new error-handling features. In particular, there is support for configuring an activity to convert exceptions to errors.

Go to Microsoft Azure Automation Graphical Authoring SDK to download the latest version.
Body.Markdown:
An update to the public preview of the Microsoft Azure Automation Graphical Authoring SDK has been released. The update includes support for new error-handling features. In particular, there is support for configuring an activity to convert exceptions to errors.

Go to Microsoft Azure Automation Graphical Authoring SDK to download the latest version.
